_howto: Newest first. Add an entry at the top each time you push an update; the website reads this file. tag: new | improved | fixed.

items.text: The goals are proper pixel art now, with red posts and mesh that ripples when you score. Go bulge the twine.

notes.title: Icons, and a hundred thousand names

items.text: Every rating in Create a Player now has its own icon. Click one to see exactly where you will start and how far you can go.
The random-name button now knows more than a hundred thousand names. You will not meet the same Finn twice.
Everyone on the ice got smaller, the way the classics did it. More room to skate, more room to make a play, and the game moves faster for it.
Our goalie was half the size he should have been, which is why the sides of the net were wide open. He now fills the net properly, hugs his post, and has to actually reach for the corners.
Goalies. They play the angle, kick out rebounds, flash the glove and wave the blocker. Catch them sliding and go five-hole.
Tap for a wrist shot that climbs, or wind up for a slap shot that stays low and hurts.
Posts and crossbars now ring. So close.
The goals were tiny. Now they are the right size next to the players: twice as wide, and it shows. Hit the post and it still does not count.

notes.title: Meet the legends you never heard of

items.text: Beer League Hockey now has its own hockey universe: every pro your player grew up watching is one of ours.
Give your player a hometown, a number, a height, a weight and a shooting hand.
Randomize your look, and lock the bits you like so they stay put.
Changed your mind about the moustache? Saved players can change their look and number any time.

notes.title: Put a face to the name

items.text: Pick a face for your player, and a country: 249 flags, from Canada to places that have never seen ice.
Choose hair, a beard, a build and your gear. They are remembered now and will show on your player as the art arrives.
Random names now match your country when we have names for it.
Stuck for a name? Hit Random name and meet your new alter ego. Or spell it out on the on-screen keyboard with a gamepad.
Hybrid Goalie joins the play styles: no party trick, no weakness.
Play style and archetype cards now have pictures.
You can delete a created player (it asks first) and choose who you take to Pick-Up.

notes.title: Create a Player, for real this time

items.text: Create a Player has a proper screen: name your skater, pick where they learned the game, who they grew up watching, how they play and who they are in the room.
Search thousands of professionals for your hockey heroes. The famous ones shape your player the most.
No more re-rolling. You see the range your choices lead to, you commit, and your player is rolled once. Just like real life, you get what you get.
Your confirmed players are kept in your browser.

Under the hood, players now have a play style as well as heroes: Sniper, Grinder, Puck-Handling Goalie and fourteen more. It shapes where a new player starts, not how good they can become. You will be able to pick one when the full Create a Player arrives.
Locker room art is in the building: lockers, benches, a whiteboard nobody looks at and a trophy cabinet with nothing in it. Not open to visitors yet.

notes.title: Who did you grow up watching?

items.text: Create a Player, first cut: pick the players you idolised as a kid and see what kind of beer leaguer that makes you. Spoiler: not a very good one. Yet.
New main menu: Pick-Up, League Dynasty, Create, Leaderboard, Options.
The nets are back to honest size while proper goals are redrawn.
Stands down both sides with an actual crowd in them. They sip their beers. Constantly.
Score and the goal lamp spins while the whole barn loses it.
Benches on both sides of centre ice, with the boys watching you skate.
Penalty boxes and a timekeeper's booth. Nobody is in the box. Yet.
Proper goals at both ends, each with a bottle perched on top. This is beer league.
The mesh ripples when you bury one.
Real boards on all four sides, with glass, support posts and player gates.
Sponsor boards behind each net, starting with The Penalty Box and Top Shelf Hockey.
The rink is now built from Tiny Mana Studios' own tile art: ice, lines, faceoff circles, creases, a centre-ice logo and side boards.
The ice wears where you skate. Carve up one corner and you will see it.
Overhead lights now glint off the ice.
The skater now uses Tiny Mana Studios' own sprite art: five drawn directions mirrored to eight, with a four-step stride, glide, hockey stop, wind-up and shot.
The pose follows what you are doing: push to stride, let go to glide, push against your travel to throw up a hockey stop.
Angled overhead camera in the style of 16-bit console hockey: the ice is foreshortened, and the boards and nets stand up off it.
The skater is now an upright figure instead of a top-down marker, and passes behind the near boards and nets.
Camera tilt slider in the tuning panel, from straight-down to a flat broadcast angle.
Title screen with the Beer League Hockey key art and a working main menu. Modes that are not built yet say Coming Soon.
Skating prototype (choose Exhibition): one skater, one puck, a full vertical rink with a scrolling camera.
Eight-way skating with acceleration, momentum, braking, gliding and carving turns.
Puck pickup, wind-up shots, board rebounds and two nets to shoot at.
Keyboard and controller support.
Live tuning panel (backquote key) for speed, friction, turning, shot power, board bounce and camera.
